rationale: The page's prose and figures are original content under the repository's Apache-2.0 licence, and the report is text-free with respect to third-party corpora -- it redistributes row hashes and scores, never prompts. One dependency is not ours to wave through: the worked G0/D1 case study quotes a single row of the frozen v1_hmda2022 mortgage benchmark, and that source's redistribution_decision is still local_only with permits_redistribution unknown. Serving this page on GitHub Pages is verbatim public redistribution of that row, so the source must be approved for publish_text before the deployment gate opens.

not_required_for.text_free_only_sources: toxicchat, beavertails, openai_moderation, safepyramid, jailbreakbench, jailbreak_classification, prompt_injections, xstest -- the report carries their row hashes and scores, not their text, so publishing it redistributes none of them.
not_required_for.mortgage_guard_bench_2k_v0_1_0: the 2,000-row draft benchmark is not quoted by this page at all; it was the payload of the withdrawn explorer artifact.

quotation_budget.note: The budget bounds how much restricted vocabulary this page may carry and fails the build if it grows. It is a change detector, not an authorization -- this file is what records the authorization requirement.

gate.current_reason: mortgage_benchmark_v1_hmda2022 is local_only / permits_redistribution unknown; no source in the ledger is approved for publish_text.
